name: @dsh-toolset/session-paths
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）会话目录编码插件：复刻宿主的 projectKey / encodeSegment 并以服务 sessionPaths 供其他插件共用

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-session-paths && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-session-paths && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-session-paths node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-session-paths tmp/cov-session-paths/report.json
